methodology.rateAndDividendSource: explicit user research assumptions, not observed rates
methodology.vegaUnits: USD per share per +1 IV percentage point
methodology.thetaUnits: USD per share per elapsed calendar day
methodology.strikeDefinition: spot * (1 + strikeOffsetPercent / 100); theoretical, not an exchange-listed strike
methodology.pnlPercentDefinition: (scenario theoretical premium - baseline theoretical premium) / baseline theoretical premium * 100
methodology.invalidIvPolicy: IV <= 0 or > 500% annual is invalid; no clamp or substitute
methodology.decomposition: Each single-factor change reprices from the original baseline; interactionPnl = total - spot-only - IV-only - time-only
limitations: Offline, historical observation snapshot with hypothetical scenarios; no live signal, forecast probability or execution permission.

Underlying composite IV and IV percentile have no independent observation timestamps. They are user-selected research assumptions anchored to a provider field, not observed contract IV or a volatility surface.
Scenario spot is a timestamped last trade, possibly after hours; technical indicators use separate completed regular-session daily bars. They are not synchronized executable quotes.
European Black-Scholes with constant rates and volatility does not model American early exercise, discrete cash dividends, jumps, volatility skew/smile or event term structure.
Continuous risk-free rate and dividend yield are explicit research assumptions in methodology, not verified current market observations. Hypothetical multiplier=100, unverified for quoted contracts.
Calendar-day ACT/365 option time and 252-session historical-volatility annualization use different clocks. Tenors and strikes are theoretical, not listed contract specifications.
No bid/ask execution, commission, slippage, financing or taxes in scenario P&L. A theoretical premium is not an available purchase or liquidation price.

Historical daily-bar corporate-action adjustment and exchange-calendar completeness are not attested by the source. Indicators are descriptive research on supplied observations, not validated strategy performance.
A low IV percentile is not a probability of a price increase, nor proof that an option is underpriced. IV and spot shocks are independent assumptions, not forecasts.
Price-only, IV-only and time-only effects each reprice from the same baseline. Their sum need not equal the full reprice; the residual records nonlinear interactions, not an extra source of profit.
Observed option bid/ask, IV and open-interest fields lacking independent timestamps remain read-only incomplete evidence; no execution eligibility or synchronization is inferred.

definitions.sma20: Arithmetic mean of 20 completed daily closes; null before bar 20.
definitions.bollinger20: SMA20 +/- 2 population standard deviations of 20 closes (ddof=0).
definitions.rsi14: Wilder RSI: seed mean of first 14 price changes, then (13*previous+change)/14; flat=50; no losses=100.
definitions.atr14: Wilder ATR: first 14 true ranges after the first close seed the mean; same smoothing as RSI.
definitions.kdj9_3_3: 9-bar high/low RSV; flat range RSV=50; initial K=D=50; K=(2*previousK+RSV)/3, D=(2*previousD+K)/3, J=3*K-2*D. Null before bar 9.
definitions.macd: EMA12 minus EMA26, each seeded with its period SMA; signal=EMA9 of available MACD, histogram=MACD-signal (not doubled).
definitions.realizedVol20Percent: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of 20 daily log returns * sqrt(252) * 100; null before 21 closes. This is historical realized volatility, not option IV.
definitions.relativeVolume20: Current daily volume divided by mean volume over current and prior 19 observed sessions; null for zero denominator or incomplete/unknown volume.
definitions.trend: Descriptive: bullish when close>SMA20 and RSI14>55; bearish when close<SMA20 and RSI14<45; otherwise neutral. Not a forecast or recommendation.
definitions.return1dPercent: (Current close / prior close - 1) * 100, based only on completed daily bars.
definitions.return5dPercent: (Current close / close five observed sessions earlier - 1) * 100.
